en-US.description:
IFCDC Barbers makes it easy to book professional barbershop appointments. Browse real haircut and style photos, choose your service, pick a barber and time, and pay securely by debit card, credit card, or PayPal.

Features:
• Book appointments with live availability
• View service photos and style gallery before you book
• Secure checkout powered by PayPal and email confirmations
• AURA assistant for quick booking help
• Manage your profile and booking history

Official app for IFCDC Barbers — smart booking powered by real style photos.

review.notes:
APP REVIEW NOTES — Build 73 (Version 1.1.9)

Review Account:
Email: apple.review@ifcdcbarbersapp.com
Password: IFCDC-Review2026!

What's new:
• Booking list shows only Super Admin–approved, publicly bookable providers (IFCDC Barbers)
• Multilingual customer UI (9 languages) with Profile language preference
• Super Admin Manual Booking Bypass Mode (Admin → Book for Client)
• Secure Checkout with card / PayPal / eligible Pay Later options
• Loyalty rewards and promo codes before payment
• Critical LTR layout fix retained

Customer booking flow:
Home → Book → provider → service → date/time → choose reward/tip/payment method → PayPal LIVE secure checkout.

Payment processing:
PayPal remains the payment processor. Choosing Card requests PayPal's guest-card billing experience; choosing PayPal requests PayPal login. Funding availability is determined by PayPal.

Rewards:
Profile → Rewards. Five points are awarded per paid, completed appointment. No points are awarded for cancelled, refunded, no-show, failed, or duplicate bookings.

Language:
Profile → Language. Selection applies immediately and persists after relaunch.

AURA:
AURA is a text assistant for booking information and does not process payments.

Account Deletion:
Profile → Delete Account → Type DELETE → Confirm

Backend: https://ifcdc-barbers-backend696.onrender.com (live PayPal)
